details:
CFITSIO is a library of C and FORTRAN subroutines for reading and writing data files in FITS (Flexible Image Transmission System) data format. CFITSIO frees programmers from the internal complexity of the FITS file format by providing a set of easy-to-use high-level routines, thereby simplifying the task of writing software that processes FITS files. At the same time, CFITSIO provides many advanced features, making it the most widely used FITS file programming interface in the astronomy community.

Security Fix(es):

CFITSIO through 4.7.0 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in ffgcls2() in getcols.c that trusts attacker-controlled heap descriptor lengths for variable-length string columns. Attackers can supply a crafted FITS file that overflows a fixed 28,800-byte stack buffer and the caller's string array, enabling arbitrary code execution.(CVE-2026-115504)
